questions.question: As the priest Ezra prayed and wept facedown before God's house in Jerusalem, who gathered around him?

answers.text: A very large assembly of Israelites

questions.question: When the people wept over their unfaithfulness to God, what covenant did Shecaniah ask them to make before God?

answers.text: Send away the foreign wives and their children
Rebuild the walls all around Jerusalem
Keep a fast for forty days and nights

questions.question: When a proclamation told all the exiles to gather in Jerusalem within three days, what would happen to anyone who did not come?

answers.text: Lose all his property and be expelled
Pay a fine in silver to the temple
Be sent back to Babylon for good

questions.question: After Ezra's leaders began investigating Israelite men who had married foreign women, they dealt with only half of them. True or false?
